references.text: The same principle of impurity through contact with what an unclean person lies on, here applied to the man with a discharge.
A parallel law stating that whatever an unclean person sits on becomes unclean.
Elaborates on the consequences of sexual contact during menstruation and the transmission of impurity.
The same principle applied to a woman with prolonged bleeding outside of her menstrual period.
General laws regarding how impurity is transferred to objects through contact.
The prophet Ezekiel uses menstrual impurity as an image of Israel's sin and uncleanness.
Prohibition against sexual intercourse with a woman during her menstrual period.
